en: A vintage divided-back postcard with Hungarian text. The front shows a color illustration of a large building complex with a church tower on the left, featuring a cross on top, and an attached multi‑windowed school or convent‑like structure with red-tiled roofs behind a line of trees. In the foreground is a landscaped park with a circular path and a fountain or ornamental basin. At the top are printed captions in Hungarian and German, and around the image and on the reverse side there is handwritten text in Hungarian. The reverse bears a Hungarian stamp with 'MAGYAR KIR. POSTA' and postmarks, along with address lines and additional handwriting.
